title: Forward catalog copy configuration
statement: Let $src$ and $dst$ be indices among the $k$ work tapes, let $w$ be a finite word, let $d$ be a configuration with a sweep phase, and let $r$ be a natural number. Define a configuration in the forward sweep phase by replacing the contents of tape $dst$ on the interval from its head position in $d$ (inclusive) to that position plus $r$ (exclusive) with the buffer representation of $w$ at the corresponding offsets. Move the heads on $src$ and $dst$ right by $r$ positions and retain all other fields and tape contents.
hypotheses_covered: $src$ and $dst$ are indices among the $k$ work tapes
$d$ is a configuration with a sweep phase
caveat: The supplied definitions do not specify the exact convention for the buffer representation.
